recentItems.title: EAST of ZAPORIZHZHIA FRONTLINE: 30-kilometer «KILL ZONE» and ROBOTIC LOGISTICS by MATTHEW SAMPSON
recentItems.description:
Three days to walk just ten kilometers under a constant swarm of drones. Two months of non-stop survival on the «zero line». And another three hellish days to get out of the position.
That’s what the frontline east of Zaporizhzhia looks like in September 2026, according to Matthew Sampson — a former US Marine Corps reconnaissance sniper who has already spent more than 770 days at war in Ukraine and returned from the trenches just days before Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner sat down for talks with Putin in Moscow.

In a candid conversation with Henry Keen, the veteran reveals what has changed in recent months: why logistics and evacuation have been taken over by ground robotic platforms, how the «kill zone» has expanded to 30 kilometers in depth, and how wounded fighters lie strapped to tracked drones around the clock while enemy FPVs hunt them.
Additionally, Sampson delivered a devastating response to officials in Washington: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Energy Secretary Chris Wright have blamed Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries for rising fuel prices in the US. The Marine’s reply is crushing: the main problem is simply that Russia is unable to defend its own plants!
